overgrow.name: Last Leaf
overgrow.description: Grass attacks grow stronger when health is low.

blaze.name: Banked Ember
blaze.description: Fire attacks grow stronger when health is low.

torrent.name: Undertow Heart
torrent.description: Water attacks grow stronger when health is low.

swarm.name: Colony Will
swarm.description: Bug attacks grow stronger when health is low.

volt-absorb.name: Storm Reservoir
volt-absorb.description: Electric hits restore health instead of dealing damage.

thick-fat.name: Dense Mantle
thick-fat.description: Insulating tissue reduces incoming Fire and Ice damage.

guts.name: Defiant Blood
guts.description: Burn or paralysis strengthens physical attacks.

shed-skin.name: Fresh Hide
shed-skin.description: Periodically has a chance to shed burn or paralysis.

sturdy.name: Last Bastion
sturdy.description: Survives a single hit from full health with at least one health.

levitate.name: Driftborne
levitate.description: Floats above Ground attacks and terrain effects.

synchronize.name: Shared Echo
synchronize.description: Returns received burn or paralysis to the attacker.

rough-skin.name: Bristle Guard
rough-skin.description: Contact attackers take damage from hard bristles.

clear-body.name: Steady Form
clear-body.description: Entry intimidation cannot lower its Attack.

water-veil.name: Dew Mantle
water-veil.description: A wet protective film prevents burns.

swift-swim.name: Current Rider
swift-swim.description: Moves faster in rain or on water.

speed-boost.name: Gathering Pace
speed-boost.description: Builds speed the longer it remains active.

natural-cure.name: Quiet Renewal
natural-cure.description: Switching out clears burn and paralysis.

pressure.name: Sovereign Weight
pressure.description: Its presence lengthens the opponent's move cooldowns.

intimidate.name: Dominant Bearing
intimidate.description: Entry lowers the opponent's Attack until it switches.

magic-guard.name: Unbroken Aura
magic-guard.description: Only direct attacks can damage it.

snow-cloak.name: Rime Shroud
snow-cloak.description: Improves dodging in hail or on snow and ice.

chlorophyll.name: Sunstride
chlorophyll.description: Sunlight and grassy Pitch terrain increase speed.
